sections.title: 1. Website Ownership & Permitted Use

Access to and use of this website is provided for general informational purposes to residents of India seeking financial product distribution, mutual fund assistance, insurance solutions, and broking partner services.

Nothing on this website constitutes direct investment advice, portfolio management services, a formal solicitation, or an offer to buy or sell securities or financial instruments.

We do not act as an independent investment adviser (RIA) or a deposit-taking entity. sections.title: 4. No Guarantee of Investment Outcomes
sections.copy: Past performance across equity markets, mutual fund schemes, or debt instruments does not guarantee future results. Lotus Capital makes no warranty, express or implied, regarding returns, capital protection, dividend distributions, or claim settlement decisions made by third-party underwriters.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Products & Terms
sections.copy: Financial products including mutual fund schemes, insurance policies, corporate fixed deposits, and Demat accounts are issued and underwritten solely by respective Asset Management Companies (AMCs), insurance companies, and broking entities. Terms and conditions set by those issuing institutions govern all contractual relationships.

sections.title: 6. Accuracy & Market Updates
sections.copy: While Lotus Capital endeavors to keep site content accurate and updated as of October 2026, market data, tax regulations, and statutory parameters are subject to frequent change. Visitors are advised to verify details with scheme information documents and policy wordings before executing financial decisions.
